scenicChapters.title: Peru Huascaran Circuit
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4767 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Llanganuco Lakes → Huaraz
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 58 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

peru-huascaran-circuit.story: Out of Huaraz and back again: 145 km, roughly 2 h 20 in the saddle. The stops in between: Chacas, Punta Olimpica, Portachuelo de Llanganuco and Llanganuco Lakes. The highest point is about 4,750 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Hardknott and Wrynose Passes
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Hardknott and Wrynose Passes
scenicChapters.narrative: For 37 km this is Hardknott and Wrynose Passes, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-the-english-lake-district-parton-.story: A 141 km round trip from Ambleside - roughly 2 h 26 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ravenglass Roman fort bath-house, Parton Roman fort and back through Ravenglass Roman fort bath-house. It strings together lakeside roads.
